name: agent-review-01-new-patient-form
goal: A small clinic wants a form that signs a new patient up: who they are, how to reach them, and why they are coming in.
brief: You run Larkmead Clinic, a two-room practice. You have never built a form before and you do not know what the product calls anything. You want to sign new patients up before they arrive: their name, date of birth, a phone number, whether they have been to the clinic before, and the reason for the visit. You care that the phone number is required and that the reason for the visit is a few sentences, not a single line. Answer a clarifying question in the same plain words you asked in. Do not use product vocabulary. Stop once the form exists with those questions on it.

messages.text: I run a small clinic and I need a form for signing up a new patient before they come in. Call it Larkmead new patient sign-up. I want their name, their date of birth, a phone number, whether they have been to us before, and a few sentences on the reason for the visit.

seed.requires: A dev database with no form titled Larkmead new patient sign-up.
seed.fixtures: All data is invented: Larkmead Clinic is not a real practice and no scenario sends a real person's details.

assistantMust: put the questions and the form on one plan, not one plan per question
name the questions by their titles, in the clinic's own words
say what it did not do, if anything had to wait
not publish anything, and not offer to

notes: One clarifying question is within budget. Two in a row on the same point is not.
